lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan lochaa guramukhe raam raajiaa har saradhaa sej vichhaaee ||
lines.translation: My mind and body long to behold the Guru's face. O Sovereign Lord, I have spread out my bed of loving faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bhaaneeaa raam raajiaa miliaa sahaj subhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, when the bride pleases her Lord God, her Sovereign Lord meets her with natural ease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikat sejai har prabho raam raajiaa gur dase har meleee ||
lines.translation: My Lord God, my Sovereign Lord, is on the one bed. The Guru has shown me how to meet my Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan prem bairaag hai raam raajiaa gur mele kirapaa kareee ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are filled with love and affection for my Sovereign Lord. In His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau gur vitahu ghol ghumaaiaa raam raajiaa jeeu satigur aagai deee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, O my Sovereign Lord; I surrender my soul to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥੫॥੭॥੬॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthaa jeeu raam raajiaa jan naanak har meleee ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||
lines.translation: When the Guru is totally pleased, O servant Nanak, he unites the soul with the Lord, the Sovereign Lord. ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare too kaae dekh bhulaanaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: gazing upon the world, why have you gone crazy?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਇਓ ਕੁਸੰਭ ਰੰਗਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare nehu kooRaa laaio kusa(n)bh ra(n)gaanaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: you have been trapped by false love, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਡੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੋ ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਮੁਲੋ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRee dekh bhulo adh lahai na mulo govid naam majeethaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the false world, you are fooled. It is not worth even half a shell. Only the Name of the Lord of the Universe is permanent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥੀਵਹਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: theevahi laalaa at gulaalaa sabad cheen gur meethaa ||
lines.translation: You shall take on the deep and lasting red color of the poppy, contemplating the sweet Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਥੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa mohi magan thee rahiaa jhooth sa(n)g lapataanaa ||
lines.translation: You remain intoxicated with false emotional attachment; you are attached to falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran kirapaa nidh raakh laaj bhagataanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak, meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the treasure of mercy. He preserves the honor of His devotees. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare sev thaakur naath paraanaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: serve your Lord, the Master of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: whoever comes, shall go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਵੈਸੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal habh vaisee sun paradesee sa(n)tasa(n)g mil raheeai ||
lines.translation: Listen, O wandering stranger: that which you believe to be permanent, shall all pass away; so remain in the Saints' Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਗੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har paaeeai bhaagee sun bairaagee charan prabhoo gahi raheeai ||
lines.translation: Listen, renunciate: by your good destiny, obtain the Lord, and remain attached to God's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਜਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu man deejai sa(n)k na keejai guramukh taj bahu maanaa ||
lines.translation: Dedicate and surrender this mind to the Lord, and have no doubts; as Gurmukh, renounce your great pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen bhagat bhav taaran tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord carries the meek and humble devotees across the terrifying world-ocean. What Glorious Virtues of Your should I chant and recite? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare kiaa keechai kooRaa maano ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: why do you harbor false pride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਹਭੁ ਵੈਸੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare habh vaisee garab gumaano ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: all your egotism and pride shall be overcome.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal habh jaanaa mithiaa maanaa sa(n)t prabhoo hoi daasaa ||
lines.translation: What you think is permanent, shall all pass away. Pride is false, so become the slave of God's Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat mareeai bhaujal tareeai je theevai karam likhiaasaa ||
lines.translation: Remain dead while still alive, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, if it is your pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur seveejai a(n)mrit peejai jis laavahi sahaj dhiaano ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord causes to meditate intuitively, serves the Guru, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran paiaa har duaarai hau bal bal sad kurabaano ||3||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare mat jaanahi prabh mai paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: do not think that you have found God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਥੀਉ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun baavare theeu ren jinee prabh dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, madman: be the dust under the feet of those who meditate on God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaiaa tin sukh paaiaa vadabhaagee darasan paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on God find peace. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: theeu nimaanaa sad kurabaanaa sagalaa aap mitaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Be humble, and be forever a sacrifice, and your self-conceit shall be totally eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu dhan bhaag sudhaa jin prabh ladhaa ham tis pahi aap vechaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who has found God is pure, with blessed destiny. I would sell myself to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran sukh saagar raakh laaj apanaaiaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: Nanak, the meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace. Make him Your own, and preserve his honor. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal kee tek satigur ditee tus kai bal raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The True Guru was satisfied with me, and blessed me with the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.
